chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Uramah, from one of our companions, from Abu al-Hasan, the Master of the Army (peace be upon him), who said:

You should say by the head of al-Husayn (peace be upon him): 'Peace be upon you, O Abu Abdullah! Peace be upon you, O Proof of Allah in His earth and His witness upon His creation. Peace be upon you, O son of the Messenger of Allah! Peace be upon you, O son of Ali al-Murtada! Peace be upon you, O son of Fatima al-Zahra!'

I testify that you established the prayer, gave the alms-tax, enjoined the good, forbade the evil, and strove in the way of Allah until the certainty (death) came to you. So may Allah send blessings upon you, living and dead.'

Then place your right cheek upon the grave and say: 'I testify that you are upon clear evidence from your Lord. I come acknowledging the sins, so intercede for me with your Lord, O son of the Messenger of Allah!'

Then mention the Imams by their names, one by one, and say: 'I testify that you are the Proof of Allah.' Then say: 'Record for me with you a covenant and a promise that I have come to you to renew the covenant, so bear witness for me with your Lord that you are the witness.'
Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Razzaz al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) — similar to it.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and ritual for visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the ritual of Ziyarah to Imam al-Husayn (as), emphasizing the renewal of the covenant (mithaq) with the Ahl al-Bayt through specific salutations and testimonies of their divine proof status. It highlights the Shia practice of seeking intercession (shafa'ah) by physically connecting with the grave, reflecting the theological belief in the Imams as the enduring witnesses to creation. The text underscores the continuity of leadership from the Prophet to the Imams, framing the visit as both an act of remembrance and a reaffirmation of allegiance.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Awrama, from one of our companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, owner of army (Al-Askar) (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘You should be saying by the head of Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>! The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup> O Proof of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> in His<sup>azwj</sup> earth, and His<sup>azwj</sup> witness upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures. The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>. The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup>, O son<sup>asws</sup> of Ali Al-Murtaza<sup>asws</sup>. The greetings be upon you<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> of Fatima Al-Zahra<sup>asws</sup>.

I testify that youasws had established the Salaat, and gave the Zakat, and enjoined for the goodness and forbade form the evil, and struggled in the Way of Allahazwj until the conviction (death) came to youasws. So may Allahazwj Send Blessings upon youasws, (of both) the living and the dead’.

Then place your right cheek upon the grave and say, ‘I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> are upon the evidence from your<sup>asws</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup>. I come acknowledging with my sins for you<sup>asws</sup> to intercede for me in the Presence of your<sup>asws</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, O son<sup>asws</sup> of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>!’

Then mentioned the Imams<sup>asws</sup> with their<sup>asws</sup> names, one by one, and say, ‘I testify that you<sup>asws</sup> all are the Proofs of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’. Then say, ‘Write for me a Covenant with you<sup>asws</sup>, and a promise that I come to you for renewing the Covenant, therefore testify for me in the Presence of your<sup>asws</sup> Lord<sup>azwj</sup> that you<sup>asws</sup> are the witness’.
Muhammad Bin Ja’far Al-Razzaz Al-Kufy, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> – similar to it.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn ‘Uramah from certain individuals of our people who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan Sahib al- ‘Askar, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, near the head of al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al- Salam, you should say this.

‘(I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O abu ‘Abd Allah. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O possessor of authority of Allah on His earth and a witness over His creatures. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O grandson of the Messenger of Allah. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O son of Ali, al-Murtada’. (I hereby declare, affirm and acknowledge that you are a ‘Alayhi al-Salam and my) submission to (your commandments), O son of Fatimah, al-Zahra’.

I testify that you performed salat (prayer), paid zakat, commanded people to do good and forbade them from doing evil deeds and strove hard for the cause of Allah until the time of your death. I appeal before Allah to grant salawat (favors and compensation to you worthy of your services to His cause) during the lifetime as well as after death.’

“Thereafter place the right side of your face on the grave and say, ‘I testify that you had clear proof about your Lord. I have come to confess to my sins so you may intercede on my behalf before your Lord, O grandson of the Messenger of Allah,’

then mention the names of ’A’immah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, one by one and say, T testify that you are possessors of authority of Allah.’ Then say, ‘Please, write down before you, as pledge and covenant that I came before you to renew the covenant, so bear witness for me before your Lord that you are the witness.’”
NOTE:Muhammad ibn Ja’far al-Raziy al-Kufiy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa ibn ‘Ubayd from those whom he has mentioned from abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, a similar Hadith.
